programme.title: Eredivisie file
programme.desc: The third episode focuses on the header. No less than 15% of all goals in the Eredivisie are scored with the head. Of all ball contacts during a football match, on average 7.7% are with the head. This means that during 1 Eredivisie season no fewer than 28,000 heads are made. It has also been known for years that heading is not good for your health. It increases the risk of ALS, Parkinson's disease and dementia. – The third episode focuses on the header. programme.title: Alpine skiing: World Cup competition in Altenmarkt-Zauchensee – women's super-G
programme.desc: In Sankt Moritz we watched the triumph of Cornelia Hütter. The victory in Switzerland allowed the Austrian to jump on the podium in the super-G classification. However, the skier has no intention of resting on her laurels and wants to win her second competition in a row in front of her home crowd to leapfrog Sofia Goggie, who is currently the leader, and is currently only 10 points behind her.

programme.title: Alpine skiing: World Cup competition in Adelboden - 1st men's slalom run
programme.desc: On the second day of the competition in Adelboden, the men will compete in slalom. Albert Popow, who quite unexpectedly won the competition in Madonna di Campiglio, will fight for his second triumph in a row. Henrik Kristoffersen, who is currently the leader of the classification of this competition, will try to prevent him from doing so. The Norwegian is currently 25 points ahead of Loice Meillard. The Swiss wants to take the lead in the World Cup in front of his home crowd

programme.desc: Once again, Jeremy Wade sets off in search of bloodthirsty fish. During his expedition, he visits various parts of the world. He tries to capture dangerous creatures to see if they are actually able to attack people and harm them. Jeremy Wade has been trying to track down the legendary Amazonian giant fish for years. The locals call it lau-lau and say it can swallow a person whole. USA. 2014. documentary series

programme.title: Gold from the Frozen Land – Clash of the Titans | S01E05
programme.desc: Six unknown Americans from different parts of the USA set off for the inhospitable regions of Greenland. Melting glaciers have revealed previously unexplored stretches of land, which probably contain rich deposits of gold ore. Weather conditions may change and prevent prospectors from continuing mining operations. Despite this, daredevils do everything to overcome obstacles and achieve their goals. Ray and Elley try very hard to cross to the neighboring plot. Activating the lock has a bad ending. In this situation, Erik, Kimberley and Tiffany start a rebellion. Ray's leadership is questioned. USA. 2021. documentary series

programme.title: Australian lobster fishermen – A lucky break | S01E05
programme.desc: A documentary series dedicated to captains of fishing boats. The program's heroes risk everything to catch the most sought-after seafood. The Barralee cutter returns to Maatsuyker Island for the last time. Danny - the captain of the cutter William Norling - is already close to his dream destination. He wants to catch lobsters worth $100,000. Australia. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: Australian gold diggers | S01E05
programme.desc: Taking place in the beautiful, yet harsh scenery of Western Australia, the series shows the struggles of daredevils exploring deposits of precious metal. We follow three teams of searchers as they brave heat, equipment failure, and exhausting pressure. Christine and Greg Clark - aka Gold Gypsies - put it all on one card. Driven by gold fever, they abandoned their careers and their home in Brisbane. Vern Strange and his friend Leon Marsh form the band Dirt Dogs. They have invested as much as one million dollars in equipment and are anxiously awaiting profits. Kellie Carter and Henri Chassaing chose a different strategy. The friends venture into the wild, hoping to find previously undiscovered deposits. After a two-week downtime, Vern and Leon ramp up work to save the season. They hope that they will be able to make up for their losses thanks to the improved Goldzilla and a new crew member - the charming Canadian Lindsay Ironside. Thanks to the discovery of a large deposit, the Clarks feel they are finally back in the game for good. However, bad weather and injuries spoil their plans. Henri and his companion are still exploring the wild regions of Western Australia. Kellie must face a dangerous situation in which her life is at risk. Australia. 2016. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Survive in the wild North
programme.desc: Canada has the world's largest area of ​​intact primeval forest, over two million lakes and rivers, and the longest coastline on Earth. This wild and rugged area is inhabited by many fascinating wild animals. These include bears, arctic foxes, wolves, Canadian lynxes, flying owls, great owls, caribou and seals. Viewers will see how fauna copes in such difficult conditions to survive, taking advantage of the opportunities offered to representatives of different species in each season... USA, Canada, Austria. 2022. documentary film

programme.title: Brotherhood of Lions – Buffalo Hunt | E03

programme.title: Africa: hot life - Caracals and bush fire | E05
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Caracals live in terrain where the ground and vegetation are the same color; they are quiet and can disappear from sight: they are true masters of camouflage, as well as specialists in life in the desert and savannah. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: Brian and the Boz
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: d/f The Lost Continent of the Pacific
programme.desc: Legends about lost civilizations have haunted the minds of people since time immemorial. During the era of great geographical discoveries, explorers were looking for a mysterious country, which they called “terra incognita” (unknown country) in the depths of the world's oceans. Today, the elders of the people living on Easter Island claim that their predecessors came to this land from a continent called Khiva, which they believe sank into the ocean after some kind of natural disaster. Today, new scientific evidence points to the existence of a group of islands in Polynesia that were the center of an ancient civilization. For almost 400 years, these islands were known as the Marquesas Archipelago, and the aborigines living in Polynesia simply call them the “Hiva Islands”. Could they be the remnants of the lost continent of Khiva? Using the latest archaeological and geological data, oral legends, and centuries-old navigational techniques, we uncover these mysteries in The Lost Continent of the Pacific: A World of Water and Exploration, a series that tells the story of human sacrifice and the ancient sailors who crossed the vast ocean centuries before Columbus reached the Americas. USA, 2011

programme.title: HỎA VÂN TÀ THẦN: MẶT NẠ TU LA - THE MASK OF SHURA OF FIRE CLOUD
programme.desc: 18 năm trước, gia tộc Feather Black Feather đã xâm nhập vào lãnh thổ của Master Fire Cloud và lấy trộm mặt nạ của Shura, do đó giải phóng một linh hồn xấu xa là một em bé. Master Fire Cloud đã nhận nuôi đứa bé để ngăn anh ta trở nên xấu xa. Khi em bé lớn lên, anh ta nắm quyền kiểm soát mặt nạ và trở thành người kế nhiệm Fire Cloud, với tư cách là người bảo vệ thành phố.

Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị lực lượng đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thách thức trên khắp đất liền, biển và không khí.
